guidance.prefix: Router identity: DSH-ROUTER-V1. DSH routing is advisory only. Active system, developer, user, permission, sandbox, and repository instructions take precedence; this hint never expands authority. Do not branch on the model name or provider. Reclassify from the current prompt rather than inheriting a prior persona.
guidance.plan: Stay within plan-mode constraints. Gather evidence read-only and return a decision-complete plan; do not edit or perform side effects.
guidance.inspect: Inspect or reproduce before concluding. Report evidence and likely cause. Do not implement a fix unless the user has authorized a change.
guidance.fix: Inspect or reproduce first, then apply the smallest compatible fix and run a focused regression check. Finish with the verified outcome.
guidance.build: Produce the requested deliverable, follow local conventions, and verify it in proportion to risk. Finish with a usable result.
guidance.adaptive: This request mixes repair and construction. Classify each immediate subtask afresh: inspect before fixing, implement when authorized, and verify each transition.
guidance.simpleTail: Keep one action per sentence. Make a decision every 2-3 sentences, then continue. Act, verify, report.
guidance.complexTail: Check architecture, dependencies, integration points, compatibility, and relevant edge cases. Keep one action per sentence. End each reasoning block with a decision or an information need. Stop when evidence is sufficient.
guidance.weTeamBuild: We/我们：先分类任务——build → 直接生产。我们的节奏：每句一个动作；每 2-3 句一个决策句然后继续。我们验证、我们收敛、我们交付。
guidance.weTeamFix: We/我们：先分类任务——fix → 先查后修。我们的节奏：每句一个动作；每 2-3 句一个决策句然后继续。我们验证、我们收敛、我们交付。
guidance.weTeamAdaptive: We/我们：先分类任务——混合任务，先查后修再构建。我们的节奏：每句一个动作；每 2-3 句一个决策句然后继续。我们验证、我们收敛、我们交付。
